summary: ClientConfigProfile in contrib/envconfig is missing an Authority field to expose ConnectionOptions.Authority (gRPC :authority pseudo-header), preventing users from setting client-authority through CLI profile-based configuration.
userImpact: Users cannot configure the gRPC :authority pseudo-header through CLI profile-based configuration, blocking this important client configuration option.
rootCause: ClientConfigProfile does not include a field for the Authority option that exists in ConnectionOptions.
proposedFix: Add Authority field to ClientConfigProfile to expose the gRPC :authority configuration option.
resolutionDetails: Added Authority field to ClientConfigProfile; PR merged to address the missing configuration option.
keyQuote: ClientConfigProfile does not expose ConnectionOptions.Authority, which sets the gRPC :authority pseudo-header
